title: European consumer credit registers
gdpr: GDPR is the common data-protection floor across the EEA. It does not unify scores. Private ACCIS-style bureaus and public central credit registers sit side by side; data-subject access (Art. 15) is the usual way to search your own file.

countries.notes: ACCIS members plus OeNB-related central aspects.
countries.access: Request your file from KSV1870 or CRIF (GDPR Art. 15). OeNB information is mainly for supervised lenders.

bureaus.name: KSV1870
bureaus.role: ACCIS member; consumer and commercial reports.

countries.public: Banque Nationale de Belgique (Central Credit Register)
countries.notes: National Bank of Belgium runs the Central Credit Register.
countries.access: Ask the National Bank of Belgium Central Credit Register for your own record.

bureaus.name: Banque Nationale de Belgique — Central Credit Register
bureaus.role: Public CCR for consumer and mortgage credit.

countries.notes: HROK private bureau; Hrvatska narodna banka public side.
countries.access: HROK subject-access plus HNB channels for the public register.

countries.notes: Private CCB/SOLUS plus CNB CCR.
countries.access: CRIF CCB or SOLUS for private files; CNB for the central credit register.

countries.notes: Experian Denmark is the main private bureau.
countries.access: GDPR access request to Experian Denmark.

countries.notes: Creditinfo Eesti plus Eesti Pank.
countries.access: Creditinfo Eesti subject access; Eesti Pank for central-bank registers.

countries.notes: Asiakastieto is the main private file.
countries.access: Request your credit information from Suomen Asiakastieto.

countries.notes: FICP is incident-focused; private Experian is limited.
countries.access: Banque de France for FICP/FCC extracts; Experian France where a private file exists.

bureaus.name: Banque de France — FICP
bureaus.role: Public negative file of credit incidents.

countries.notes: SCHUFA dominates consumer scores; Bundesbank is more business/supervisory.
countries.access: SCHUFA Datenkopie (Art. 15). CRIF, Creditreform Boniversum, and Infoscore/Experian also take access requests.

countries.notes: TIRESIAS private; Bank of Greece public.
countries.access: TIRESIAS (Teiresias) subject access; Bank of Greece for central data.

countries.notes: BISZ KHR private/interbank; Magyar Nemzeti Bank public.
countries.access: BISZ (KHR) for the interbank file; MNB for the central bank.

countries.notes: Private EURISC-style files plus the public Centrale dei Rischi.
countries.access: CRIF, Experian or Cerved for private files; Banca d'Italia for Centrale dei Rischi (larger exposures).

countries.notes: Creditinfo plus the national central bank.
countries.access: Creditinfo Latvija Art. 15; Latvijas Banka for the public register.

countries.notes: Creditinfo plus Lietuvos bankas.
countries.access: Creditinfo Lietuva; Lietuvos bankas for central-bank data.

countries.notes: Creditinfo plus the Central Bank of Malta.
countries.access: Creditinfo Malta; Central Bank of Malta.

countries.notes: BKR registers most credit agreements; Experian also present.
countries.access: BKR inzage (your own BKR report). Experian NL where a private file exists.

countries.notes: BIK is the main consumer file; CRIF and NBP-related public aspects.
countries.access: BIK report (raport BIK); CRIF Poland; NBP for central-bank related data.

countries.notes: Equifax Iberica private; Banco de Portugal CRC.
countries.access: Banco de Portugal mapa de responsabilidades; Equifax Iberica for the private file.

countries.notes: Biroul de Credit private; Banca Națională a României public.
countries.access: Biroul de Credit access request; BNR for the public side.

countries.notes: CRIF SCB plus Národná banka Slovenska.
countries.access: CRIF Slovak Credit Bureau; NBS for the public register.

countries.notes: SISBON system; AJPES and Banka Slovenije public.
countries.access: SISBON access via participating banks; AJPES / Bank of Slovenia for public registers.

bureaus.name: SISBON
bureaus.role: Exchange of information on bank clients.

countries.public: Banco de España Central de Información de Riesgos
countries.notes: ASNEF/Experian concentrate on delinquencies; CIR is the public CCR.
countries.access: Equifax ASNEF and Experian Spain for private files; Banco de España CIR for the public register.

countries.notes: UC and Creditsafe; no single public CCR of the euro-area type.
countries.access: UC and Creditsafe GDPR access.

countries.notes: Three nationwide CRAs; not an EU ACCIS map row, kept for comparison.
countries.access: Statutory credit file from Experian, Equifax and TransUnion UK.
